name: Adept ancestral solver
plain: Euler ancestral with optional time-varying eta, a phase noise multiplier, a modified derivative, and an adaptive noise calibration. Adaptive noise can restart the whole run once it has measured enough samples.
math: η_t=η·1.08 (p<0.3), ·0.95 (p<0.7), else ·1.02. σ↑=min(σ′,η_t√(σ′²(σ²−σ′²)/σ²)), σ↓=√(σ′²−σ↑²). x=x+d(σ↓−σ)+n·s·σ↑. Phase noise: multiplier by piecewise progress. Adaptive: excess=(|Δx0_k|/|Δx0_{k−1}|)/(σ′/σ), collected by bins; after calibrating, x reset to x_initial and i=0.
label: from code
surprise: Adaptive noise restarts sampling from x_initial after calibration, so the first calibration steps are discarded model calls.
